Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

在交接件中加入「Sigma 偵測規則：資產、信任邊界與測試資料」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：為無害的合成程序日誌設計selection與filter；先列AND、OR與NOT真值表，再將每個測試案例連到規則預期，避免直接套到正式告警。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：為無害的合成程序日誌設計selection與filter；先列AND、OR與NOT真值表，再將每個測試案例連到規則預期，避免直接套到正式告警。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver rule YAML or equivalent logic, 100 labels and before/after confusion matrices.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Sigma detections：Assets, trust boundaries and test fixtures: Design selection and filter over harmless synthetic process logs; enumerate AND/OR/NOT truth tables and bind each fixture to expected behavior before production alerting. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Design selection and filter over harmless synthetic process logs; enumerate AND/OR/NOT truth tables and bind each fixture to expected behavior before production alerting. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。為無害的合成程序日誌設計selection與filter；先列AND、OR與NOT真值表，再將每個測試案例連到規則預期，避免直接套到正式告警。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Design selection and filter over harmless synthetic process logs; enumerate AND/OR/NOT truth tables and bind each fixture to expected behavior before production alerting. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 為無害的合成程序日誌設計selection與filter；先列AND、OR與NOT真值表，再將每個測試案例連到規則預期，避免直接套到正式告警。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
steps.checkEn: Design selection and filter over harmless synthetic process logs; enumerate AND/OR/NOT truth tables and bind each fixture to expected behavior before production alerting. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Sigma以可讀YAML描述日誌來源、選擇條件與偵測邏輯，需在實際資料欄位上驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Sigma describes log sources, selections and detection logic in readable YAML and requires validation against actual fields.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 為無害的合成程序日誌設計selection與filter；先列AND、OR與NOT真值表，再將每個測試案例連到規則預期，避免直接套到正式告警。
knowledge.textEn: Design selection and filter over harmless synthetic process logs; enumerate AND/OR/NOT truth tables and bind each fixture to expected behavior before production alerting.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: precision=TP/(TP+FP)，recall=TP/(TP+FN)；修改過濾器時兩者都要檢查，不能只減少警報。
knowledge.textEn: Precision=TP/(TP+FP) and recall=TP/(TP+FN); evaluate both after filtering changes instead of only reducing alert volume.
